title: Invoicing & payments View shows the Finance tab and lets the user see invoices
preconds:
1. See Financial Data ON.
  2. A user has a role with Invoicing & payments View only.
steps:
1. Open Work Orders and open a work order.
  2. Find the Finance tab on the work order.
  3. Open invoices reachable from the work order.
  4. Open invoices from a part sale.
expected:
The Finance tab is shown on the work order.

Invoices can be opened.

There are no create, edit or reverse options.
